title: docs(site): put Docs first in the objectstack.ai top navigation
body:
Fixes #28973

## What changes

`apps/docs/lib/layout.shared.tsx`: `baseOptions().links` gains `{ text: 'Docs', url: '/docs', active: 'nested-url' }` as its first entry, so the objectstack.ai top nav reads Docs, Why, Blog, Product. One file, +2 lines (the entry and a one-line comment).

## Why

The maintainer asked whether a nav without Docs made sense, agreed to add it, and handed it to the docs lane (quoted on #28973). Why and Blog lead to the www.objectos.ai blog and Product to www.objectos.ai, so nothing in the nav reached this site's own `/docs`. Every layout spreads this array (DocsLayout, and HomeLayout on home and `/blog`), so one entry adds the link site-wide, and `nested-url` highlights it on every docs page. Merging Why and Blog is left out, as the maintainer decided.

## Verification

- The entry has the same shape as the `Blog` entry beside it (`text`, `url`, `active: 'nested-url'`). No test or script pins the links array (`git grep` over `apps/docs`).
- CI `apps/docs` type-check and build run on this head. The deployed site is checked after landing.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
